reply_text: I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I logged the 23 May deadline for the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form as unverified. I couldn't check it: none of the files I can share with her mention Thornbury. I suggested she get the account owner or the contract to confirm it before anyone relies on it. I also suggested she find out which year they meant, since today is 14 October 2026 and 23 May 2026 has already passed.
